capabilities: Export notes to PDF, Word, EPUB, Markdown, and HTML
Batch export folders preserving directory structure
Merge files into a single document with table of contents
Expand note embeds with cycle detection and depth limit
Copy attachments and rewrite links in exports
extras: All processing is local with no telemetry collected. PDF export requires the desktop app and is not offered on mobile. The manifest mentions exporting query results, but the README states Dataview queries are not executed during export.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in tools to export notes and folders into shareable formats like Word, EPUB, or Markdown bundles, or to batch-export while preserving structure.
summary: Exporter that converts notes, folders, or selected files into PDF, Word, EPUB, Markdown bundles, and HTML, with batch and merged export options.
